## How it was checked

- [ ] Scenario tests pass (`./gradlew :core:domain:test`)
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has a scenario in `ScenarioCatalog` and a row in `docs/testing/test-matrix.md`
- [ ] Tried in the emulator (screenshots for UI changes)
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour changed (spec, user guide, Play Store docs)

## Privacy check

- [ ] No new permission, or the new permission is justified in `docs/play-store/permissions.md`
- [ ] No notification content, numbers or names written anywhere except the encrypted local database
